'''2017 MPC Mark Sebring DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Sebring]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Sebring]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
